notes.title: Demo Update #2 – Black Screen, Performance & More!
notes.notes:
[p]Fellow merchants![/p][p][/p][p]We’re back with [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2350790/view/514086719457330052?l=spanish"]yet another update[/url] to the [i]Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault[/i] demo! This one brings some big improvements based directly on your reports and Steam reviews. We’re moving fast, and your feedback is proving to be ever so helpful. Keep it coming![/p][p][/p][p]Let's see what's new in today's patch.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/e2313f08144df355859756256b56238f8a2d587b.png"][/img][/p][h2]Fixes & Improvements[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Resolved the black screen issue that was affecting many users with HDDs (especially during the intro sequence).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Major performance boost[/b] and smoother overall experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Demo size reduced from [b]27 GB to just 5 GB[/b] (yes, really!).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemy damage reduced by 20%[/b] across the board for better balance.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]stuttering issues[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a soft lock where [b]Trained Taalik[/b] could get stuck on certain props.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted an [b]enemy trigger[/b] that was activating as soon as you entered certain rooms.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the [b]on-screen prompt in the shop showcase[/b], which was displaying incorrect controls.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a typo in [b]Sliver’s interaction prompt[/b] (it said “Hot touch” – not intentional 😅)[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]mouse-based combat aiming[/b]! It’s enabled by default, but you can toggle it in Settings if you prefer the classic feel.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Your feedback is invaluable[/h2][p][/p][p]Thank you again for your reports, your patience, and your incredible support. This is the [b]second patch in two days[/b], and we’re committed to making [i]Moonlighter 2[/i] the best it can be before release.[/p][p][/p][p]If you haven’t already, we’d love to hear your thoughts on the shop system, especially what you feel is missing or what made the original [i]Moonlighter[/i] shop feel so special. Some of those changes may take time, as they involve deeper design decisions, but our goal remains the same: to deliver a shop system that’s engaging, strategic, and truly worthy of the series.[/p][p][/p][p]🔗[url="https://forms.gle/uoAjzBqkcPnUToYo6"] [u]Feedback Form
[/u][/url]⚙️ [u][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2350790/discussions/0/596277387327440160/"]Steam Discussion Thread[/url][/u][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2350790/discussions/0/596277387327440160/"]
[/url]💬 [u][url="https://discord.com/invite/HWSNpdBVPe"]Join us on Discord[/url][/u][/p][p][/p][p]Before we go, just a little reminder:

Will has never been an almighty hero. He’s just a merchant with a dream, always going the extra mile to make it work. And so are we.[/p][p][/p][p]Let’s hustle.
[b]– The Moonlighter 2 Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update – Performance, UI, and Your Feedback
notes.notes:
[p]Fellow merchants! 
[/p][p]We’re happy to announce that the update to the [b]Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault demo is live![/b]
[/p][p]It brings [b]improved keyboard & mouse support - including smoother inventory management and better UI navigation[/b]. It’s not perfect yet, but it’s a step forward, and the whole team is already hard at work on more improvements across all control schemes.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/cabc6bd0e6691c3f4aa63af5dbd3e1b85ebcaa67.png"][/img][/p][p]
[b]Thank you so much for playing the demo and sharing your thoughts[/b]. With Moonlighter 2 trending on Steam Next Fest, we’re thrilled to see so many of you stepping into the world of Tresna. But what’s truly overwhelming is the volume and care behind your feedback. [b]From Discord to Steam to socials - now that we’re listening and are taking your comments seriously.[/b]
[/p][p]We know the demo isn’t flawless. You’ve flagged issues - from black screens to performance hiccups - and we want to assure you those are high on our list. Fixes are in progress. We won’t be able to address everything before the end of Next Fest, but this is just the beginning. [b]This is the first demo of Moonlighter 2, and our journey together is far from over.[/b]
[/p][p][b]We’re building this game alongside you, and we’re committed to shaping it into something we can all be proud of.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Your feedback is already helping.
[/h3][p]Last update, we focused on the shop system - what’s new, what’s changed, and why. We’ve received a flood of insights from both returning Moonlighter 1 players and newcomers alike, and we’re so grateful for your honesty. If you haven’t shared your thoughts yet, please do! We’re especially keen to hear more about how the shop feels and what could make it more engaging, strategic, or satisfying.
[/p][p]🔗 [url="https://forms.gle/uoAjzBqkcPnUToYo6"][u]Feedback Form[/u][/url][/p][p]⚙️ [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2350790/discussions/0/596277387327440160/"][u]Steam Discussion Thread[/u][/url][/p][p]💬 [url="https://discord.com/invite/HWSNpdBVPe"][u]Join us on Discord[/u][/url]
[/p][p]We’re learning. We’re trying. We’re improving - one update at a time.[/p][p]Keep your feedback coming. Let’s make something truly special, together! [/p][p][/p][p]~ Digital Sun Team[/p][p]
[/p]
